name: ModelVariant677_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant677_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (sparks released in rows from model points drift towards the camera as flipbook sprites, each spent spark becoming a ring that throws five sprites outwards and turns a striped band); for a non-negative request it prints the work size, reads the 0xC-byte command row indexed by the request for the start delay, radius and spark and ring colours, packs eleven texture images and seeds the sparks, rings and bursts, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 4 while a ring is active, 1 on the first frame with every element inactive and 2 after that; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the PAL header-694 and 761 images build it through french_model_variant/variant694_entry.c without the work-size printf and its format string and bind its image and command tables 0x28 lower. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
